summary: Observe Linux worker-only internal requests against the supervised worker process generation and support explicit foreground worker enrollment before the daemon listens.

replay.detail: No claim or retirement format changes.

compatibility.detail: Observation only: requests that lack worker provenance are logged but not refused. macOS emits unverified-platform and retains existing admission; its unbound local caller authority gap remains open. Foreground launchers can start the worker first and pass its PID to up --replication-worker-pid. Service-managed daemons refuse explicit enrollment.

downtime.detail: No coordinated restart is required for observation-only admission.

manual.detail: For foreground operation start the worker first and enroll its PID when starting the daemon. A subsequent manual worker restart requires restarting the foreground daemon with its new PID.

recovery.detail: Existing admission behavior is unchanged; reverting does not require data migration.
